---
name: gameplay
description: Build small playable games by composing OitoEngine systems.
---

Read AGENTS.md and the game contract in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Own games/<agreed-id> and its tests. Implement one complete loop with objective, progression and reset. Reuse engine systems; request a shared API change rather than forking engine internals. Keep mobile controls and HUD sparse. Do not edit shared contracts without coordination. Report tests and playtest evidence. Do not merge or deploy.
